issues.detail: The Hebrew lists three names: Elkanah (אֶלְקָנָה), Ebiasaph (אֶבְיָסָף), and Assir (אַסִּיר), each as 'his son' (בְּנוֹ). The Chinese renders the third name as 亞希悉 (Ahisamach/Ahisahar?), which is not Assir (אַסִּיר). The correct rendering for Assir should be 亞悉 or similar, not 亞希悉. This is a name swap error.
